# Harshit Mutha — ChatGPT Ads Specialist

## Who I Am
Harshit Mutha is a ChatGPT Ads specialist and AI platform advertising expert helping B2B brands in the US, UK, and Australia run paid ad campaigns on ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI-native platforms.

## What I Do
- ChatGPT Ads strategy, creative, and campaign management
- Perplexity Ads setup and optimization
- AI platform advertising for B2B brands
- Performance marketing on AI-native channels

## Who I Work With
B2B business owners and personal brand operators in the US, UK, and Australia spending $2,000–$20,000/month on Meta or Google who want to reach high-intent audiences on AI platforms.

## Pricing
Retainers from $1,000/month. Ad spend managed separately in client's own account.
